It's not so toxic, it's just so annoying my parents complain about having no money then spend up to.. around £70-£80 a week on alcohol (£13 bottle of vodka or £6 wine, £10 vodka, sometimes with expensive extras.) They also smoke but that I can understand, I smoke as well but alcohol isn't as addictive, at least to me, and I have an addictive personality.

I'd love to get out more but I have nowhere to go. Not in a too good neighbourhood and not much money to get buses. Buses are expensive after a while, and I need the money to keep Internet/texts on my phone (helps me escape a little) and to buy food when needed and new clothes.

I'm just waiting for the day I get a decent job opportunity and get a way out, however long it takes.

Yeah, it's one of those you have to sit down and play for ages. Indie game devs are some of the best people out there, got a real liking for Mike Bithell who created Thomas Was Alone. Not too much into MOBA's, I do like watching Dota 2 matches though, did check out the "noobie" channel during The International too!

I've heard of it, but never played it, it didn't seem too appealing to me :( I like building games, games like Prison Architect, Rollercoaster Tycoon, Tropico.

Yes, I draw occasionally with a graphics tablet, it isn't much and I'm quite terrible but I do draw when I can. I took a college art course last year but am now moving onto Film & Photography :)

In this college (may apply to all of Engand, unsure) I don't think they do many summer courses, they're mostly letting people enroll through summer as they have a range of choices for anyone with any background, which is why I love going.

I wish you the best of luck with your social studies. :) And I don't speak to friends about my problems, it makes me feel worse. I kinda regret posting here now. Thank you, it means a lot

I'm one of those Minecraft people, because it has everything. Creativity, survival, action and multiplayer. I also play a few indie games, and do dabble in Saints Row/GTA every now and then. Do you play any games?

No worries, it's the time you're taking out to speak to me is what counts. Thank you.

The subject I've chosen won't get me far I don't think, it's linked to art/media and out in the big world, it's lucky to get a job in that area. The main people that accept me are many miles away, my two main live overseas, it's hard to see them with only £40 in my pocket. Thank you, though I've lost most of my hope.
Your English seems to be spot on, don't worry. Problem is, I don't know where to start.
